description: Source file defining the NodeServiceManager as an enum with static methods for managing a node service including starting, stopping, executing commands, and parsing JSON responses. It also includes internal helpers and extensions for testing.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Asynchronously starts the node service, returns an optional error message.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Asynchronously stops the node service, returns an optional error message.

methods.name: serviceCommand
methods.description: Builds command-line arguments for the node service command.

methods.name: runServiceCommandResult
methods.description: Executes the service command and parses the response, returning a CommandResult.

methods.name: errorMessage
methods.description: Analyzes CommandResult to determine if there's an error message to report.

methods.name: withJsonFlag
methods.description: Ensures '--json' flag is included in command arguments.

methods.name: parseServiceJson
methods.description: Parses JSON output from service response into ParsedServiceJson.

methods.name: mergeHints
methods.description: Merges error messages with hints for better diagnostics.

methods.name: summarize
methods.description: Summarizes the last line of text for concise logs.
